caption_zh: 发生于足心。可见形状不规则的褐色斑片。建议做病理/皮肤镜检查以明确诊断（色素痣/黑色素瘤）。
caption_zh_polish: 在足底出现了形状不规则的褐色斑块，这种情况可能是色素痣或黑色素瘤。建议进行病理学或皮肤镜检查以进一步明确诊断。
caption_zh_polish_en: Irregular brown patches are present on the sole of the foot, which may indicate a melanocytic nevus or melanoma. It is recommended to undergo pathological or dermatoscopy examination for a more definitive diagnosis.
caption: Irregular brown patches are present on the sole of the foot, which may indicate a melanocytic nevus or melanoma. It is recommended to undergo pathological or dermatoscopy examination for a more definitive diagnosis.
label: melanoma-in-situ

caption_zh: 边界清晰的白色斑片。建议做Wood灯、皮肤镜或病理检查，明确是否为白癜风、贫血痣等疾病。
caption_zh_polish: 这种描述表明可能存在皮肤上的白色斑块，建议进行Wood灯检查、皮肤镜检查或病理检查，以明确诊断是否为白癜风、贫血痣等疾病。
caption_zh_polish_en: This description suggests the presence of white patches on the skin. It is recommended to perform Wood's lamp examination, dermatoscopy, or pathological examination to confirm whether it is vitiligo, anemia spots, or other diseases.
caption: This description suggests the presence of white patches on the skin. It is recommended to perform Wood's lamp examination, dermatoscopy, or pathological examination to confirm whether it is vitiligo, anemia spots, or other diseases.
label: mycosis-fungoides

caption_zh: 形状不规范的黑色斑块，中央呈红色。建议做皮肤镜和/或病理学检查，明确是否为脂溢性角化症、基底细胞癌或黑色素瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 该患者表现为形状不规则的黑色斑块，中央呈红色，需考虑脂溢性角化症、基底细胞癌或黑色素瘤等疾病。为明确诊断，建议进行皮肤镜检查和/或病理学检查。皮肤镜检查可以帮助评估病变的表面特征和结构，而病理学检查则通过镜下观察组织病变的细胞学结构，从而确定病变的性质和类型。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient presents with irregularly shaped black patches with red centers, raising suspicion of conditions such as seborrheic keratosis, basal cell carcinoma, or melanoma. To establish a definitive diagnosis, a skin dermoscopy and/or pathological examination are recommended. Dermoscopy can help evaluate the surface features and structures of the lesion, while pathological examination involves microscopic analysis of the cellular structure of the tissue lesion to determine its nature and type.
caption: The patient presents with irregularly shaped black patches with red centers, raising suspicion of conditions such as seborrheic keratosis, basal cell carcinoma, or melanoma. To establish a definitive diagnosis, a skin dermoscopy and/or pathological examination are recommended. Dermoscopy can help evaluate the surface features and structures of the lesion, while pathological examination involves microscopic analysis of the cellular structure of the tissue lesion to determine its nature and type.
label: squamous-cell-carcinoma-in-situ

caption_zh: 发生于面部。皮损由黑色丘疹和斑疹组成。建议做病理/皮肤镜检查以明确诊断（黑色素瘤）。
caption_zh_polish: 面部黑色丘疹和斑疹的皮损可能是黑色素瘤的表现，为了明确诊断建议进行病理学或皮肤镜检查。
caption_zh_polish_en: The lesion on the face consisting of black papules and macules may indicate melanoma. To confirm the diagnosis, it is recommended to undergo pathological or dermatoscopic examination.
caption: The lesion on the face consisting of black papules and macules may indicate melanoma. To confirm the diagnosis, it is recommended to undergo pathological or dermatoscopic examination.
label: basal-cell-carcinoma

caption_zh: 发生于胫前皮肤溃疡。表现为黑色-黄色伤口；边缘轻度隆起。考虑皮肤软组织感染或皮肤肿瘤。
caption_zh_polish: 患者出现的症状与胫前皮肤溃疡有关，这种溃疡呈黑色-黄色，边缘轻度隆起，可能是皮肤软组织感染或皮肤肿瘤。在诊断方面，需要进一步进行体格检查和必要的实验室检查来明确病因。
caption_zh_polish_en: The patient's symptoms are related to a shin skin ulcer, characterized by a black-yellow wound with slightly raised edges, possibly indicative of a skin soft tissue infection or skin tumor. Further physical examination and necessary laboratory tests are needed for a definitive diagnosis.
caption: The patient's symptoms are related to a shin skin ulcer, characterized by a black-yellow wound with slightly raised edges, possibly indicative of a skin soft tissue infection or skin tumor. Further physical examination and necessary laboratory tests are needed for a definitive diagnosis.
label: squamous-cell-carcinoma
